title: find_matching_entry clones crl_default_issuer on every call
description:
In pkix-revocation/src/crl.rs:964, find_matching_entry clones the crl_default_issuer Name into a mutable effective variable at the top of every invocation, even when the CRL is direct (is_indirect=false) and the effective issuer is never mutated.

What goes wrong: For direct CRLs (the common case), every check_revocation call pays an unnecessary allocation to clone the issuer Name. This is an O(1) allocation per call, but it's on a hot path in batch validation and entirely avoidable.

Location: pkix-revocation/src/crl.rs:964

Recommendation: For the direct-CRL path (is_indirect=false), skip the clone and compare against crl_default_issuer directly. Only clone when is_indirect=true and the effective issuer may change per-entry.
